reviews.comment: I had the pleasure of taking two of Professor Potvin's classes and cannot recommend her enough. She is so smart, so caring, and makes each class engaging. I don't think a professor has ever helped me grow more than her. Take her if you have the chance!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: I took Dr. Potvin for ENGL 460 and she was by far one of my favorite professors from this semester. She is a great lecturer; she is animated and infectious. I had a lot of fun in this class and I learned quite a lot, we had a few hands-on activities, which isn't usually expected out of an English class. Definitely take her if you can!

Professor Potvin is the best prof I've had at A&M. I took her for English 104 and the content & our essay topics were engaging and honestly fun! + I've really improved as a writer. However, I had a hard semester, and had poor attendance, & tanked my grade completely. She worked to help me, and I ended with an A! She really cares about her students.
